description: MainActivity class for an Android app managing notes; handles UI initialization, note loading, search, and navigation to note editor.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity displaying list of notes with search functionality and the ability to add or edit notes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up RecyclerView, toolbar, FAB button, and repository.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Reloads notes when activity resumes to reflect any changes.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Fetches all notes from the repository and updates the adapter.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates menu and sets up search view filtering.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles user click on a note item to open it in the editor.

methods.name: onItemLongClick
methods.description: Handles long-press to delete a note.
